description: This file implements functionality for automatically managing neighbor access points (APs) within a wireless network, including adding and deleting neighbor entries, configuring neighbor bands and enabling/disabling the feature, and reloading neighbor configurations for specific APs.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne s_setNeighbourAP(T_AccessPoint * pAP,T_AccessPoint * targetAP)
methods.description: Adds a specific access point to the neighbor list of a target access point or updates it if already present.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne s_delNeighbourAP(T_AccessPoint * pAP,T_AccessPoint * targetAP)
methods.description: Removes a specific access point from the neighbor list of a target access point.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_autoNeighAdd_vapSetDelNeighbourAP(T_AccessPoint * pAP,bool set)
methods.description: Enables or disables the auto neighbor addition feature on a given access point.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_autoNeighAdd_radioSetDelNeighbourAP(T_Radio * pRad,bool set)
methods.description: Enables or disables neighbor addition across all access points associated with a given radio.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_autoNeighAdd_vapReloadNeighbourAP(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Reloads neighbor configuration for a specific access point by deleting and re-adding its neighbors.

methods.name: void s_setNeighbourBands_pwf(void * priv _UNUSED,amxd_object_t * object _UNUSED,amxd_param_t * param _UNUSED,const amxc_var_t * const newValue)
methods.description: Handler to update the neighbor bands configuration.

methods.name: void s_setEnable_pwf(void * priv _UNUSED,amxd_object_t * object _UNUSED,amxd_param_t * param _UNUSED,const amxc_var_t * const newValue)
methods.description: Handler to enable or disable the auto neighbor feature.

methods.name: void _wld_autoNeighAddition_setConf_ocf(const char * const sig_name,const amxc_var_t * const data,void * const priv)
methods.description: Set configuration callback for the auto neighbor addition feature, handling updates to neighbor bands and enable flags.
